name: B10-0158/2026 (The Left) – Case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It expresses deep concern about reports that Georgia's government prosecutes, intimidates and jails opposition figures, activists and journalists for political reasons. It calls for the release of opposition politician Elene Khoshtaria and everyone held for using their rights to speak, assemble and join groups. It asks Georgia to guarantee fair trials, protect these rights and keep its courts free of political control.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and asks Georgia to act.
- It concerns Elene Khoshtaria, other detainees, journalists and activists in Georgia.
- Parliament sends the text to Georgia's leaders and European Union institutions; no deadline is set.
